auth.v1.AcceptInviteRequest.title: AcceptInviteRequest
auth.v1.AcceptInviteRequest.description:
AcceptInviteRequest redeems an invite and sets the new member's password.
 The code is the credential, which is why this RPC is public.

auth.v1.CreateServiceAccountResponse.title: CreateServiceAccountResponse
auth.v1.CreateServiceAccountResponse.description:
CreateServiceAccountResponse returns client_secret exactly once. Filament
 does not persist it and Zitadel cannot retrieve it again.

serviceAccountScopes.title: service_account_scopes
serviceAccountScopes.description:
service_account_scopes are requested by non-interactive clients. The
 provider owns these values so clients do not need provider-specific
 project IDs or reserved scope knowledge.

auth.v1.GetAuthConfigResponse.title: GetAuthConfigResponse
auth.v1.GetAuthConfigResponse.description:
GetAuthConfigResponse tells clients how to authenticate. An empty issuer
 means no provider is configured: the UI renders without a session and every
 other AuthService RPC is unimplemented.

auth.v1.GetSessionRequest.title: GetSessionRequest
auth.v1.GetSessionRequest.description:
GetSessionRequest resolves the caller behind the session cookie. It is the
 UI's sign-in check: unauthenticated means show the login page.

auth.v1.InviteMemberResponse.title: InviteMemberResponse
auth.v1.InviteMemberResponse.description:
InviteMemberResponse carries the invitation an admin shares out of band.
 Nothing is emailed.

canManage.title: can_manage
canManage.description:
can_manage reports whether the caller may invite, re-role, or remove.
 The UI renders read-only when false.

auth.v1.LoginRequest.title: LoginRequest
auth.v1.LoginRequest.description:
LoginRequest carries the credentials filament's own login page collected.
 A successful login answers with an HttpOnly session cookie that every later
 RPC carries; nothing about the provider reaches the browser.

auth.v1.LogoutRequest.title: LogoutRequest
auth.v1.LogoutRequest.description: LogoutRequest ends the session and clears its cookie.

auth.v1.Member.title: Member
auth.v1.Member.description: Member is one user of a tenant.

auth.v1.RegisterRequest.title: RegisterRequest
auth.v1.RegisterRequest.description: RegisterRequest creates a tenant and its first admin.

auth.v1.Role.title: Role
auth.v1.Role.description:
Role is a filament permission level. The vocabulary is filament's, not the
 provider's: an adapter maps whatever grants it stores onto these.

auth.v1.RotateServiceAccountSecretRespon.title: RotateServiceAccountSecretResponse
auth.v1.RotateServiceAccountSecretRespon.description:
RotateServiceAccountSecretResponse returns the replacement secret exactly
 once. The previous secret is invalid after rotation.

auth.v1.ServiceAccount.title: ServiceAccount
auth.v1.ServiceAccount.description:
ServiceAccount is a non-human identity used by automation such as the
 filament CLI. Its client secret is never returned by list operations.

connect-protocol-version.title: Connect-Protocol-Version
connect-protocol-version.description: Define the version of the Connect protocol

code.description: The status code, which should be an enum value of [google.rpc.Code][google.rpc.Code].

message.description: A developer-facing error message, which should be in English. Any user-facing error message should be localized and sent in the [google.rpc.Status.details][google.rpc.Status.details] field, or localized by the client.

details.description: A list of messages that carry the error details. There is no limit on the number of messages.

type.description: A URL that acts as a globally unique identifier for the type of the serialized message. For example: `type.googleapis.com/google.rpc.ErrorInfo`.

value.description: The Protobuf message, serialized as bytes and base64-encoded. The specific message type is identified by the `type` field.

debug.title: Debug
debug.description: Deserialized error detail payload. The 'type' field indicates the schema. This field is for easier debugging and should not be relied upon for application logic.

connect.error_details.Any.description: Contains an arbitrary serialized message along with a @type that describes the type of the serialized message, with an additional debug field for ConnectRPC error details.

google.protobuf.ListValue.description: A JSON array whose elements may be any JSON value.

google.protobuf.NullValue.title: NullValue
google.protobuf.NullValue.description:
`NullValue` is a singleton enumeration to represent the null value for the
 `Value` type union.

 The JSON representation for `NullValue` is JSON `null`.

google.protobuf.Struct.description: A JSON object whose property values may be any JSON value.

google.protobuf.Value.description: Any JSON value: `null`, number, string, boolean, array, or object.

ingestion.v1.CandidateStatus.title: CandidateStatus
ingestion.v1.CandidateStatus.description: CandidateStatus says how to read an empty candidates list.

ingestion.v1.CandidateValue.title: CandidateValue
ingestion.v1.CandidateValue.description: CandidateValue is one value the user may pick to satisfy a requirement.

secret.title: secret
secret.description: secret marks the field as sensitive: rendered masked, stored as a ref.

fields.title: fields
fields.description:
fields describes members when type is FIELD_TYPE_OBJECT. An empty list
 means the object is intentionally free-form.

visibleWhen.title: visible_when
visibleWhen.description: visible_when conditionally includes this field based on a sibling field.

ingestion.v1.ConfigField.title: ConfigField
ingestion.v1.ConfigField.description: ConfigField describes one connector configuration field.

ingestion.v1.ConfigSchema.title: ConfigSchema
ingestion.v1.ConfigSchema.description: ConfigSchema describes the configuration accepted by a connector.

replication.title: replication
replication.description:
replication is the effective source behavior derived from the immutable
 connection configuration. Sinks report UNSPECIFIED.

executionModes.title: execution_modes
executionModes.description:
execution_modes lists the modes this connection can take part in, derived
 from connector capabilities and runtime support. Route compatibility is
 still decided by ValidatePipeline.

ingestion.v1.Connection.title: Connection
ingestion.v1.Connection.description:
Connection is a reusable, tenant-scoped source or sink. It holds the
 connection-scoped config (host/bucket/credentials) shared by every pipeline
 node that references it, keeping connection details in one place instead of
 duplicated inline on each pipeline. version is an optimistic lock, mirroring
 Pipeline: an update must carry the version it last read.

ingestion.v1.ConnectorKind.title: ConnectorKind
ingestion.v1.ConnectorKind.description: ConnectorKind distinguishes a source from a sink in the catalog.

ingestion.v1.ConnectorSpec.title: ConnectorSpec
ingestion.v1.ConnectorSpec.description: ConnectorSpec describes one registered source or sink connector.

workerConfiguration.title: worker_configuration
workerConfiguration.description:
worker_configuration shapes this pipeline's runs. Omit it to configure the
 pipeline's workers later through UpdatePipeline.

effectiveReadMode.title: effective_read_mode
effectiveReadMode.description: Unspecified for message streams, which do not use row cursor read modes.

ingestion.v1.EdgeValidation.title: EdgeValidation
ingestion.v1.EdgeValidation.description:
EdgeValidation is one edge's authoritative read/write verdict. Write modes
 apply to the complete source-to-destination route.

ingestion.v1.EnumOption.title: EnumOption
ingestion.v1.EnumOption.description: EnumOption is one ordered choice for an enum or list config field.

ingestion.v1.ExecutionDesiredState.title: ExecutionDesiredState
ingestion.v1.ExecutionDesiredState.description: ExecutionDesiredState is the persisted intent for continuous execution.

ingestion.v1.ExecutionMode.title: ExecutionMode
ingestion.v1.ExecutionMode.description:
ExecutionMode is independent of replication and write semantics.
 Unspecified preserves bounded execution for existing clients.

ingestion.v1.ExecutionObservedState.title: ExecutionObservedState
ingestion.v1.ExecutionObservedState.description:
ExecutionObservedState describes progress toward the requested state.
 An idle source can remain RUNNING; lack of arriving records is not a failure.

revision.title: revision
revision.description: Opaque revision for SignalRunRequest.expected_revision; clients echo it.

reason.title: reason
reason.description: User-facing explanation, including actionable blocked/failed conditions.

lastCommittedAt.title: last_committed_at
lastCommittedAt.description: Epoch milliseconds of the most recent durable commit; zero means none yet.

ingestion.v1.ExecutionStatus.title: ExecutionStatus
ingestion.v1.ExecutionStatus.description:
ExecutionStatus is the user-facing state of continuous execution, loaded from
 durable state. GetRun/ListRuns remain authoritative after missed live events.
 Pause/resume and worker restarts retain the run ID; starting again after stop
 creates a new run. Desired and observed states can differ while draining.

ingestion.v1.FieldType.title: FieldType
ingestion.v1.FieldType.description: FieldType drives UI form controls for connector configuration fields.

ingestion.v1.ListConnectionsRequest.title: ListConnectionsRequest
ingestion.v1.ListConnectionsRequest.description:
ListConnections filters by tenant; kind UNSPECIFIED returns both sources and
 sinks.

sinceMs.title: since_ms
sinceMs.description:
since_ms/until_ms window on started_at (inclusive/exclusive, epoch
 millis); 0 means unbounded. Runs that never started are excluded.

ingestion.v1.NotificationType.title: NotificationType
ingestion.v1.NotificationType.description:
NotificationType identifies how a pipeline notification is delivered.
 Unspecified is an input sentinel and cannot be persisted.

ingestion.v1.Notifier.title: Notifier
ingestion.v1.Notifier.description:
Notifier holds settings, plain config, and secret references, never secret
 values. Webhook config carries url; secret_refs carries headers.

ingestion.v1.NotifierEvent.title: NotifierEvent
ingestion.v1.NotifierEvent.description:
NotifierEvent identifies an event kind a notifier can deliver. Unspecified is
 an input sentinel and cannot be persisted.

ingestion.v1.NotifierInput.title: NotifierInput
ingestion.v1.NotifierInput.description:
NotifierInput replaces the rule's settings. Secret fields in config are
 extracted and stored as secrets; on update, an omitted secret field keeps
 the reference echoed in secret_refs.

ingestion.v1.PaginationRequest.title: PaginationRequest
ingestion.v1.PaginationRequest.description:
PaginationRequest narrows a List response to one page. Absent means the
 full result. page_size is defaulted and capped server-side;
 cursor is an opaque token from a prior response, absent meaning the first
 page.

ingestion.v1.PaginationResponse.title: PaginationResponse
ingestion.v1.PaginationResponse.description:
PaginationResponse reports how many items matched before the page was cut,
 plus opaque cursors for the adjacent pages. Absent cursors mean no page in
 that direction.

workerConfiguration.title: worker_configuration
workerConfiguration.description:
worker_configuration shapes this pipeline's runs by default. It lives on
 the pipeline rather than the version so editing it cannot mint a version
 and orphan the resource checkpoints keyed by the old one.

executionMode.title: execution_mode
executionMode.description: Default execution mode for subsequent starts; existing pipelines are bounded.

ingestion.v1.Pipeline.title: Pipeline
ingestion.v1.Pipeline.description: Pipeline is mutable metadata plus a pointer to its current graph version.

cursors.title: cursors
cursors.description:
cursors contains durable-incremental overrides. An all-resource edge may
 configure several resources; a resource-specific edge may configure only
 its own resource. Omitted resources use connector auto-detection.

destinationResource.title: destination_resource
destinationResource.description: Optional destination name for this resource in any execution mode; source identity is unchanged.

ingestion.v1.PipelineEdge.title: PipelineEdge
ingestion.v1.PipelineEdge.description:
PipelineEdge routes from a source node to a sink node. An empty resource routes
 all enabled resources; a named resource is an additive per-resource route.
 Standard connections carry a per-resource read mode and a destination-route
 write mode. All edges on the same source-to-destination route must use the
 same write mode. CDC connections carry no read lever and support append
 (default) or merge writes.

ingestion.v1.PipelineEdgeRun.title: PipelineEdgeRun
ingestion.v1.PipelineEdgeRun.description: PipelineEdgeRun ties one compiled pipeline edge to the run it produced.

ingestion.v1.PipelineNode.title: PipelineNode
ingestion.v1.PipelineNode.description:
PipelineNode is one source or sink on the canvas. connection_id references the
 reusable Connection that supplies the connector and connection-scoped config
 (host/bucket/credentials). config/secret_refs are the per-node PIPELINE-scoped
 overlay (prefix, path, target table) shallow-merged over the
 connection config at run time, with the node overlay winning on key conflicts.

ingestion.v1.PipelineSchedule.title: PipelineSchedule
ingestion.v1.PipelineSchedule.description: PipelineSchedule includes the server-owned identity and derived fire times.

ingestion.v1.PipelineScheduleOverlapPoli.title: PipelineScheduleOverlapPolicy
ingestion.v1.PipelineScheduleOverlapPoli.description:
PipelineScheduleConfig is the client-owned portion of a pipeline's schedule.
 Omit it when creating a pipeline that should only run manually.

ingestion.v1.ReadMode.title: ReadMode
ingestion.v1.ReadMode.description: ReadMode is the per-resource read lever on Standard connections.

ingestion.v1.ReplicationMode.title: ReplicationMode

ingestion.v1.Requirement.title: Requirement
ingestion.v1.Requirement.description:
Requirement is configuration the chosen read/write combination involves. It is
 emitted whether or not the value is set so a picker can render from it:
 satisfied means the value is configured, blocking means the run would fail
 as-is. Unsatisfied and non-blocking means auto-detection covers it.

ingestion.v1.ResourceValidation.title: ResourceValidation
ingestion.v1.ResourceValidation.description:
ResourceValidation reports the read modes a routed resource supports and any
 requirements for its selected read/write combination. CDC resources report
 no Standard read modes.

ingestion.v1.RunEvent.title: RunEvent
ingestion.v1.RunEvent.description:
RunEvent is the event envelope forwarded by the run stream. event_type is the
 wire token (e.g. "written", "completed"). replay marks a snapshot-synthesized
 event rather than a live fact.

checkpoint.title: checkpoint
checkpoint.description:
Legacy bounded cursor payload. Continuous progress is read through GetRun;
 continuous events do not carry raw customer cursors.

ingestion.v1.RunEventFields.title: RunEventFields
ingestion.v1.RunEventFields.description: RunEventFields contains the optional measurements carried by a run event.

cpuSeconds.title: cpu_seconds
cpuSeconds.description: Worker pod usage folded from run.heartbeat facts.

createdAt.title: created_at
createdAt.description:
Lifecycle stamps in epoch millis; 0 means unset. created_at is row birth,
 scheduled_at the intended fire time (scheduled runs only), requested_at
 when the run was queued for dispatch. started_at/ended_at above are the
 worker's own start and finish.

executionStatus.title: execution_status
executionStatus.description: Present for continuous runs. records/bytes above reflect committed progress.

ingestion.v1.RunInfo.title: RunInfo
ingestion.v1.RunInfo.description: RunInfo is the run-level persisted state exposed by the API.

executionMode.title: execution_mode
executionMode.description:
Unspecified inherits the pipeline mode. Explicit values override this start.
 Continuous creates a durable activation; unavailable profiles are rejected.

ingestion.v1.RunOptions.title: RunOptions
ingestion.v1.RunOptions.description:
RunOptions overrides the engine's throughput defaults for a run. Every field
 is optional: a zero value defers to the engine default downstream.

clientToken.title: client_token
clientToken.description:
client_token salts the idempotency key so a deliberate re-run differs from a
 double-click; reusing a token dedupes to the same runs.

options.title: options
options.description:
options overrides engine throughput defaults for every run this call
 produces. Unset (or any zero field) defers to defaults.

workerConfiguration.title: worker_configuration
workerConfiguration.description:
worker_configuration overrides the pipeline's own for this call only, field
 by field: an empty field inherits the pipeline's value. The resolved result
 is stamped onto each run, so editing the pipeline afterwards cannot change
 a run already requested.

ingestion.v1.RunResourceState.title: RunResourceState
ingestion.v1.RunResourceState.description: RunResourceState reports progress for one resource in a run.

ingestion.v1.RunSignal.title: RunSignal
ingestion.v1.RunSignal.description: RunSignal is a lifecycle command sent to a run.

ingestion.v1.RunStatus.title: RunStatus
ingestion.v1.RunStatus.description: RunStatus is the persisted lifecycle state of a run.

expectedRevision.title: expected_revision
expectedRevision.description:
Optional CAS for continuous desired state. A stale revision is rejected.
 Absent permits a transition against the current revision.

ingestion.v1.SignalRunResponse.title: SignalRunResponse
ingestion.v1.SignalRunResponse.description:
Continuous success confirms persisted intent, not completed worker drainage.
 Bounded responses leave execution_status absent.

shouldReplay.title: should_replay
shouldReplay.description:
replay first emits events synthesized from the current snapshot (each marked
 replay=true) so progress is correct on reconnect, before live facts stream.

executionMode.title: execution_mode
executionMode.description: Unspecified preserves the saved mode; affects future starts only.

executionMode.title: execution_mode
executionMode.description: Unspecified means bounded. Validation and submission must use the same mode.

ingestion.v1.ValidatePipelineRequest.title: ValidatePipelineRequest
ingestion.v1.ValidatePipelineRequest.description:
ValidatePipelineRequest carries the graph inline so unsaved canvas state
 validates the same as a persisted version.

errors.title: errors
errors.description: Graph-level failures: dangling node refs, unknown connections.

ingestion.v1.WorkerConfiguration.title: WorkerConfiguration
ingestion.v1.WorkerConfiguration.description:
WorkerConfiguration is how a pipeline's workers are shaped. It is a subset of
 a Kubernetes pod spec so a manifest fragment pastes in unchanged. Resources
 merge per key when a run overrides a pipeline; node_selector and tolerations
 replace wholesale.

ingestion.v1.WorkerResources.title: WorkerResources
ingestion.v1.WorkerResources.description:
WorkerResources sizes the worker that executes a run, shaped like a Kubernetes
 ResourceRequirements: resource name ("cpu", "memory") to quantity string
 ("500m", "2Gi"). A missing key is unset and inherits, and only the Kubernetes
 dispatcher consults them.

ingestion.v1.WorkerToleration.title: WorkerToleration
ingestion.v1.WorkerToleration.description:
WorkerToleration mirrors a Kubernetes toleration. Fields are the Kubernetes
 strings verbatim: operator "Equal" (default) or "Exists"; effect
 "NoSchedule", "PreferNoSchedule", "NoExecute", or empty to match all.

ingestion.v1.WriteMode.title: WriteMode
ingestion.v1.WriteMode.description:
WriteMode is the destination-route write lever. Delete remains an internal
 engine policy; merge is selectable for CDC routes.

metrics.v1.AggregateRow.title: AggregateRow
metrics.v1.AggregateRow.description: AggregateRow.values[i] is request.metrics[i] for this group.

metrics.v1.Metric.title: Metric
metrics.v1.Metric.description:
Metric is an aggregatable measure over runs. RUN_COUNT/RUN_RECORDS/RUN_BYTES
 are sums; RUN_DURATION is the mean duration in milliseconds over terminal
 runs (percentile variants can be added as new values later).
 RUN_MEMORY_USAGE is the mean peak working set in bytes and RUN_CPU_USAGE the
 mean CPU seconds, both over runs that reported usage (a zero column means
 "no usage reported", e.g. runs outside a cgroup, and is excluded).

metrics.v1.MetricDimension.title: MetricDimension
metrics.v1.MetricDimension.description: MetricDimension names a runs column usable for grouping and filtering.

metrics.v1.MetricFilter.title: MetricFilter
metrics.v1.MetricFilter.description:
MetricFilter narrows a query; values are dimension values as strings
 (a RunStatus number or a pipeline id).

metrics.v1.MetricGranularity.title: MetricGranularity
metrics.v1.MetricGranularity.description: MetricsGranularity is the bucket width for timeseries queries.

metrics.title: metrics
metrics.description:
metrics are computed together per bucket; point values align with this
 order positionally.

tzOffsetMinutes.title: tz_offset_minutes
tzOffsetMinutes.description:
tz_offset_minutes shifts bucket boundaries east of UTC so DAY buckets
 match the viewer's local calendar day.

metrics.v1.Timeseries.title: Timeseries
metrics.v1.Timeseries.description:
Timeseries.key is the group_by dimension's value as a string
 (e.g. "3" for a COMPLETED-status series). Points are dense: every bucket
 in [since_ms, until_ms) is present, zero-filled, ascending; all series of
 a response are index-aligned. When a filter covers the group_by dimension,
 one series per requested value is returned in request-value order.

metrics.v1.TimeseriesPoint.title: TimeseriesPoint
metrics.v1.TimeseriesPoint.description: TimeseriesPoint.values[i] is request.metrics[i] for this bucket.

tags.name: auth.v1.AuthService
tags.description:
AuthService is filament's identity surface. It is optional: with no
 provider configured the server leaves it unimplemented and the API is
 unauthenticated.

 The session RPCs run before the caller holds a bearer token, so they are
 the server's only public procedures and carry no tenant_id — there is no
 tenant until sign-in completes. Everything else is authenticated and
 scoped to the caller's own tenant.

tags.description:
MetricsService is a generic, read-only aggregation surface: two query
 primitives (bucketed timeseries, windowed aggregate) parameterized by
 metric and dimension enums. New metrics/dimensions are enum additions;
 the RPC surface never changes.
